title: A Unit Outside the Euler-Liar Subgroup
statement: Let $N>1$ be an odd nonprime integer, and suppose no prime square divides $N$. There is a unit $u$ modulo $N$ outside the subgroup of units satisfying $\left(\frac{u}{N}\right)=u^{(N-1)/2}$ in $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$, where the left side is the Jacobi symbol, viewed modulo $N$.
hypotheses_covered: For every prime $p$, $p^2$ does not divide $N$
